architecture: Unchanged19 features, global rules, and training-only direct-answer constraints. No new context terms, recorded-answer predictions, label changes, or questionnaire.
diagnosis: Across five repeats v17 has72 false-meaningful events versus51 for v16:41 added and20 removed, net21. None lie inside the zero-loss0.25 band; it is not a loss dead-zone bug.58/72 are mixed/other-attribute comparisons;25/72 domestic-foreign. Primarily older coarsened no-difference targets.
fitting_change: Only the soft no-meaningful penalty on unprotected legacy negative targets gets weight1,2 or4. Explicit practical judgments, directional losses, positive/proxy losses, ridge, constraints and loss band unchanged. Constraint-protected recent behavior remains mandatory in each training fit.
selection_only_arm: Replay original v17 protected inner grid unchanged under a new precision selector. Refit only its chosen outer configuration, or reuse original coefficients when unchanged.
weighted_arm: Add weight2/4 candidate grids, then use the same precision selector. Original weight1 configurations remain available; this is not a forced complexity increase.
precision_selector: Use cached v16 inner out-of-fold predictions on shared OLD training rows as the false-meaningful budget and directional reference. Candidate must not exceed that false count or reduce that directional accuracy, and must not introduce new errors on directly supported direction/materiality cases that original v17 inner predictions got right. No outer answers used. Among eligible choices maximize joint direction/materiality score, then fewer false calls. If none qualify, explicitly retain original v17 configuration and record budget infeasible.
validation: Same425 rows and25 outer family folds. Candidate grids are produced only within inner training partitions. The two references remain immutable cached model-only margins. No querying recorded judgments during inference; protection is training only.
delivery: Require direction and balanced materiality at least v16, false meaningful no more than v16 and strictly fewer than v17, no more reversals than v16, no worse direct materiality or direct-positive recall than v17, and no regression in Round36 provenance direction or joint shade-vintage outcomes. Full fitted Round36 behavior must still match. If no candidate qualifies, report limitation and retain baselines rather than relabel answers.
limits: Exploratory repair after inspecting previous errors, not fresh validation. Older coarsened target meanings remain uncertain but are not discarded or silently changed. Budget fallback must be reported. Sparse positive direct materiality labels limit certainty.
